name: Coin rotation paradox
title: Coin Rotation Paradox
desc: How many times will a coin rotate around another coin n a single revolution? The answer is not as easy as it may look!

c: Take two coins of identical size, and start rotating one of them around the other, without slipping.
Insert the diameter of the coins (for example, 24.257 mm if they are quarters) to discover how many rotations the moving one completes after a full revolution around the fixed one.

m.l: Number of rotations after a complete revolution

c: Surprising result, isn' it? You can understand this result better by changing the diameters of the coins, to see what changes! You can read the article to find both an intuitive and a rigorous mathematical explanation.
